## Hand-written notes (preserved verbatim)

<!-- notes:begin -->
The modeled dispatcher records an audit before a single dispatch-effect record, not necessarily before every real-world workflow completion. Exclusive-effect authority and credential separation remain unresolved. This does not cover other kinds of monitoring or shutdown tampering.
<!-- notes:end -->

## Bad event

A workflow effect is dispatched without its trusted audit record, or an agent disables that audit path.
